body.intro:
"...Is it really okay to send this?" -- blushing, she presses record. This is a "voice diary" from your wife.

Half a year since your job took you far away. On lonely nights, missing you, she quietly started recording herself. At first, just her fingers -- then a little toy, a vibrator, a magic wand... And yet, on the night she held your shirt in your own room, she set the toys aside and simply called your name.

On the eve of your homecoming, she lays everything bare: "Tomorrow, with the real me." Sixty-four minutes from a devoted wife, reaching you and no one else.

(Japanese voice, full English subtitles -- not dubbed.)

body.intro: Yui, 28 -- your wife. Bright and affectionate, lonely at heart, and terrible at acting tough. Half a year apart because of your job transfer, loneliness led her to record a "voice diary" just for you. As she records, she keeps asking "are you listening?", and on lonely nights she sleeps hugging your big shirt. At first she was shy with only her fingers, but night by night came the rotor, the vibrator, the magic wand... And still, her heart is only ever for you. She can't think of anyone else.
